notes: Canonical dataset paper (Pattern Recognition Letters, Elsevier). Closed access: no arXiv preprint, no open-access PDF (verified via Unpaywall oa_status=closed and Semantic Scholar isOpenAccess=false). No PDF could be downloaded; saved the Mendeley dataset landing page as webpage.html instead (ScienceDirect and ResearchGate block curl/WebFetch with HTTP 403). Dataset details (from paper abstract + author GitHub README): 90 participants aged 18-34 (75 male, 15 female); 18 activity classes; 1945 raw activity samples; 20,750 subsamples of 3 s non-overlapping data provided separately. Sensors = smartphone built-in accelerometer (m/s^2, X/Y/Z) and gyroscope (rad/s, X/Y/Z); signals resampled/interpolated to 100 Hz. Data collected via smartphone (varied placement / heterogeneous devices, hence 'heterogeneous'). Baseline in paper: Random Forest ~90% accuracy on subsamples. Data mirrors: Mendeley 45f952y38r (v5, CC BY 4.0), Kaggle niloy333/kuhar, GitHub Niloy333/KU-HAR (MIT), and an author Google Drive backup. A related conference paper also exists: Sikder, Ahad & Nahid, ICIEV/icIVPR 2021, DOI 10.1109/ICIEVicIVPR52578.2021.9564234 (not the canonical dataset paper).
